prompts.static: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel sprite animation asset for HumanLastRampart. Reference images: FIRST hero generated.png is STYLE ONLY (big head 1/3 height, chunky clean pixels, thick dark one-native-pixel outline, ~3 shades/material). Gunner back/front references are IDENTITY: brown spiky hair, navy blue coat with cream trim, pale shoulder pads, brown leather diagonal strap, big brown boots; gunner is not white-haired hero. Archer reference gives the approved stocky 73px body proportions, NOT its bow. Gunner weapon must be an unmistakable long musket: straight steel barrel, wooden stock, visible shoulder butt and lock, never a bow or staff. True transparent background, no floor, no shadows, no labels, no grid. Entire figure and gun visible. Crisp low resolution pixel art enlarged with nearest-neighbor, no antialiasing, no painterly texture. Equal size characters, consistent face/clothes/head mass, aligned ground level, ample transparent gutters between cells. ONE SINGLE full-body gunner idle, BACK THREE QUARTER view facing up-right. Brown spiky hair, back of navy coat, cream trim and shoulder pads, leather strap from shoulder to opposite hip, big sturdy brown boots, long musket held in right hand beside body tilted slightly up, clear steel barrel and wooden butt. Resting ready posture. Height equivalent 73 native pixels head 24. Show mostly back, not face. Center whole human body, generous margins, no text.
